title: Google Cloud Network Congestion From a Misapplied Configuration Change
summary: A configuration change intended for a small number of servers in one region was applied to a larger set of servers across several neighboring regions. This reduced network capacity and caused significant congestion and elevated latency for Google Cloud and some Google services.
impact: Elevated latency and packet loss for services in affected regions over multiple hours; some Google services were also affected.

timeline.description: The configuration change takes effect and network congestion begins.
Engineers diagnose the issue and restore capacity; exact times are not stated here.

causal_factors.description: The change was applied to more servers and regions than intended, reducing network capacity.
Congestion also hampered the network used by engineers to diagnose and repair the problem.

lessons.statement: Configuration changes need validated scope limits so a mistake cannot span many regions.
lessons.recommended_control: Enforce scope checks and keep an independent management path for recovery.
